core_problem_solved: To provide a Java-based template engine that allows for a clean separation of presentation (HTML, SQL, etc.) from business logic (Java code) using the Velocity Template Language (VTL).
key_features: A simple but powerful template language (VTL)
Renders templates with data provided in a Java 'context' object
Can be used to generate any text-based format
era_and_niche: The original, legacy Maven coordinate for the popular Velocity template engine, widely used in the early 2000s, particularly in applications following the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. The project became a top-level Apache project and moved to a new, official groupId. The modern and actively maintained successor is **`org.apache.velocity:velocity-engine-core`** (as part of the Apache Velocity Engine).
